text_blocks.snippet: Psychotherapy add-on codes are used in conjunction with primary psychotherapy codes to indicate additional services or complexities during a session. Some common add-on codes include those for interactive complexity (90785), family therapy (without the patient present, 90846), and extended sessions (99354, 99355). Additionally, codes like 90833, 90836, and 90838 are used when psychotherapy is performed with an evaluation and management (E/M) service.
snippet_highlighted_words: interactive complexity (90785), family therapy (without the patient present, 90846), and extended sessions (99354, 99355)

text_blocks.snippet: 1. Interactive Complexity (90785): This add-on code is used when a psychotherapy session involves elements that complicate the delivery of care, such as using a language interpreter, dealing with a patient's mental health symptoms that make communication difficult, or using play equipment or physical devices. It can be added to codes like 90832, 90834, 90837, and others, but it requires specific documentation explaining which elements of interactive complexity were present according to Headway.
